notes.title: NEW HOTFIX COMING SOON!
notes.content:
Hi Youtubers,

We hope that you are enjoying your road to fame with the new features and gameplay added in the #CityStories Update! We are so glad to receive your feedback and keep improving the game in a new upcoming hotfix coming soon.

Below you can check some issues and questions we have been receiving, along with some workarounds until the new patch is live:

[h3][b]Main reported issues and temporary workarounds[/b][/h3]

[b]Game menus may get blocked after opening a new package.[/b]
We are working on fixing this issue in the upcoming hotfix. If you have ever experienced it, you can unlock the menu again by going to sleep and moving on to the next day.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40308403/1b98fad05f73fa4b9b3effa8db6be1f2e1758619.png[/img]

[b]If your backpack is full and you try to pick up a new item, the item may disappear if you leave the place[/b]
We are fixing this bug in the next patch too. Until then, try to keep some empty slots in your backpack before exploring and completing any quest. If you find a new item and your backpack is full already, you can dump or sell items to get some free space right away, and then pick up the new item again, but don't leave the scene to avoid the item disappearing!

If you are at home and you are going to go out to start a new adventure, you can also save some of your items in your storage to get some empty slots before it. Also, don't forget that you can expand your backpack with additional slots at Geektopia to be able to carry more items at once!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40308403/22cb9ec5b96e7bff29d034c2012d3893ac1a1cc6.png[/img]

[b]General minor bugfixing[/b]
[list]
[*] We are fixing the block when opening the camera or Map while drinking water
[*] We are fixing the bug that prevents players from completing Adam's "Five videos with secrets" quest.
[*] Some typos in the dialogues will be revised.
[*] Other minor fixes will be fixed.
[/list]

[h3][b]Other frequently asked questions:[/b][/h3]

[b]New cutscenes and rewards from friendship quests do not show up in old save games.[/b]
With the #CityStores Free Update Launch, we have improved several cutscenes and dialogues when building a new relationship with NPCs, as well as new rewards after completing some of their stories, but these improvements will just appear for relationships you haven't completed yet. If there are some NPCs you want to grow a friendship with, and you haven't struck up a relationship with them yet, this is your chance to start it right away!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40308403/f5274164a64f62f27a31f3fe4250841ba38b22ab.png[/img]

[b]Taking photos with video games in the background does not capture the trend for Instalife.[/b]
To allow you to focus on capturing specific trends rather than capturing several others unintentionally, we've slightly adjusted the trends-catching system, making it no longer possible to capture a video game trend when it is placed in the background. Just pick it up, hold it and then take a nice pic to capture the trend! This will help you capture only the trends you want for your channel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40308403/fd27aba77a033f2d3c9a3b1115814bf24990e2f0.png[/img]


There are other minor adjustments we will cover in the next patch to improve your gaming experience according to your feedback. Thank you so much for your support and for being part of the Youtubers Life Community.

And don't forget that you can also check out our official FAQs in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1493760/discussions/0/3473990693213288709/]Steam forums[/url] to find useful information and more workarounds!

[*] Fixed an issue where the music from an area didn’t reproduce after a friendship event in said area.
[*] Sliders on the settings menu now play a sound when selecting a new value.
[*] Fixed an issue where you were softlocked inside buildings.
[*] Fixed an issue where you weren’t able to talk to DJ Cerulean during her friendship event.

notes.title: YOUTUBERS LIFE 2 OFFICIAL FAQs!
notes.content:
Hello, Youtubers!

If you are looking for some answers about Youtubers Life 2, this might be your post! We have gathered some of the most Frequently Asked Questions of the game for you. We hope that this helps you in your career as a Youtuber.

[u][h3][b]FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS:[/b][/h3][/u]
[b]I divorced an NPC and now they hate me. What can I do?[/b]
You have to use the Er-Brainlyzer, which you can buy at Er-Tech Innovation Center, in order to reset the relationship. That way you can befriend them again.


[b]Why can’t I give away certain objects?[/b]
Some objects can’t be gifted or given away because they are required to complete a quest or they are key to the development of your Youtuber career. That’s why, in order to avoid you giving them away accidentally, we have taken away the ability of doing so altogether.

 
[b]Gigi is gone! How do I make her come back?[/b]
Before Gigi disappears, she will tell you to take care of her AFK plant. Then, you’ll get the plant and a watering can. In order to complete the quest, you’ll need to place this plant on a piece of furniture, and then you’ll see it’s special and you can interact with it. If you get close to the plant with the watering can, you’ll see the plant has a heart of friendship. Keep watering the plant until the heart is full and something will surely happen! When Gigi disappears, you have to water the plant every day until you reach 1 full heart of relationship in order for her to come back. The plant can be watered by placing it on a piece of furniture.

 
[b]Why can’t I go past 500 000 viewers on livestreams?[/b]
You’re not doing anything wrong! That’s the current limit of viewers you can have on a stream, so you can just focus on keeping up the good work to gain more subscribers and coins with your streamings.

 
[b]Why can’t I get more than 10 000 000 subscribers? [/b]
Don’t worry, that’s the current limit of subscribers that you can have in your channel, so if you reach this number, it means that you have become the most famous Youtuber! After that, you can keep enjoying your stardom at NewTube City by capturing new trends, making more friends, grabbing secret rewards, or progressing in other game quests.

 
[b]I can’t increase my level of friendship with Agora and Grace![/b]
Agora and Grace don’t progress in friendship and they don’t have any friendship events.

 
[b]My room has suddenly gone dark![/b]
It might be that you have accidentally turned off the lights of your house. They can be turned on again by pressing the F key or the left joystick of the controller. But who knows, maybe you prefer to keep a dimmer light for your next video...

 
[b]Why can’t I finish a quest that requires a storm if I go there when it’s raining?[/b]
Because rainy days and stormy days are not the same. Stormy days only occur in summer, so you have to wait for that season to be able to complete the quest! In order to make sure that the weather is right, you can check the weather status. On rainy days, there’s a cloud with raindrops. When there’s a storm, there’s lightning too in the weather status icon. Always look out for that!

 
[b]Tattoos, piercings, and different hairstyles aren’t showing up when I try to change my character’s style. How can I get them?[/b]
You need to purchase tattoos, piercings, and new hairstyles at the hairdresser’s counter before going to the chair. Once you do that, they should appear.

 
[b]I did a livestream with the USB Adam gave me but the USB doesn’t disappear after doing it, and the trend it contains is now white. What should I do?[/b]
You have to talk to Adam after completing the livestream in order for the USB to disappear.

 
[b]What should I do if the game tells me “Not enough render points”?[/b]
If that happens, that means you need to upgrade your computer. The option to upgrade it is unlocked after the first time your computer crashes, then the drone tells you to replace the broken components with new ones at Leet Point. Then you can interact with your computer to upgrade it by adding new components. Each component you can get at Leet Point will add a certain number of render points to your computer, so the better the component is, the higher number of render points you will be able to spend while editing your videos.


[b]After having obtained the NewTube trophy of the season, can we equip the drone? [/b]
Of course! You should be able to equip your brand new golden drone using the Drone App that you'll find in the phone menu.


[b]Can I decorate the new room that gets added when I marry an NPC?[/b]
The new room cannot be edited because it’s the other character’s room. If you get divorced and they move out, the room will disappear.


[b]Can I make time go slower?[/b]
Time can’t be slowed down in the game. But if you need to take a break, you can always open your phone and think about your next move, since that will freeze time inside the game.


[b]The texts and options in the main menu have gone crazy and they don’t display the correct titles! What is going on?[/b]
Something like this is probably happening because the game doesn't have permission to read the language files. You can either try reinstalling the game in a different unit/drive (that can be chosen in the installation settings of Steam) or you can change the security permissions of the drive in which you have currently installed the game.


[b]Why can’t I do an unboxing of any of the items I have?[/b]
Unboxings can only be made with games that you have not played yet and objects that display a box symbol next to them. So, for example, if you’ve already played a game, you won’t be able to do an unboxing of it.


[b]Why is it so hard to get stars when recording a video?[/b]
Getting good ratings for your videos can be challenging at first, so we recommend you focus on a specific star and then pick cards that will make that particular star go up. That should help improve the rating of your videos!


[b]Where can I get the costume for Inoxtag’s quest?[/b]
You can get the guard costume from Edgar, the Geektopia comic store owner, located at the south-east corner of the downtown neighborhood, at the fountain square. Once you get the costume from Edgar, remember to wear it before talking to the guards again to gain access to the laboratory.

[b]I’m stuck on a quest and I can’t seem to find a solution, what should I do?[/b]
We have a wonderful community ready to help you. Don’t be shy and post your doubts in the Steam Discussions or head to our Discord server, where other fellow Youtubers and our team will be glad to help you complete that quest that’s giving you trouble.


[u][h3][b]KNOWN ISSUES:[/b][/h3][/u]
[b]When I finish the last mission and go through the machine, the game gets stuck and Dr. Ermingaut won’t talk. I’m just stuck on the beach.[/b]
We have detected this issue and it is currently being worked on for future updates. It is a very rare issue, and if you find yourself in this situation, you can try restarting the game and trying again.


[b]I accidentally pressed kiss while my spouse was asleep, and now time is advancing even past bedtime and I can’t move.[/b]
If you wait until 8AM, your spouse will get out of bed and then your character will pass out. However, you won’t wake up until the following day. We have detected this issue and it is currently being patched. It should be fixed in the next update.


[b]I gave Gigi’s AFK plant away, what can I do to get it back?[/b]
Gigi’s AFK plant can’t be given away anymore, but if you gave it to someone before the game was updated, you can contact us and send us your save files so we can take a look and fix it for you.


[b]When I upgraded my house, my computer was sent to my storage, and when I put it back the upgrades were gone. What can I do about this?[/b]
We have already detected this issue and it is currently being patched in the next update. Meanwhile, to avoid this bug you can move your computer to the center of your current room before upgrading your house in the City Hall or if an NPC moves to your home. Once the new room is created, you can then place your computer back close to the wall. 


[b]Other common issues we have detected and are currently being worked on for future updates:[/b]
[list]
[*] We have detected that sometimes when you interact with a character, the game freezes and you should wait for your character to pass out at 4:00AM before being able to do anything.
[*] We have noticed that the game may suddenly appear to be cropped and it may show only a part of the screen.
[/list]


We hope that these solutions help you become the best Youtuber in the world! We encourage you to visit our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1493760/discussions/?snr=1_2108_9__2107]Steam discussions[/url] or participate in our [url=https://discord.com/invite/aDEmU2j7KC]Discord server[/url] to know even more.

notes.title: DEVS ANSWER YOUR QUESTIONS! THE PRESENT AND FUTURE OF YOUTUBERS LIFE 2
notes.content:
What's up, promising Youtuber!

Last week we were happy to announce the AskTheDev Youtubers Life 2 Edition where you sent us your questions about the development of Youtubers Life 2. Now, the dev team has answered some of the most frequently asked questions!

THANK YOU for participating and sending us all your marvelous questions! We have gathered all of them we have received through [url=https://discord.com/invite/aDEmU2j7KC]Discord[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/youtubers_uplay]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/youtuberslifegame/]Instagram[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/youtuberslifegame/]Facebook[/url], and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1493760/discussions/0/3199245116725303742/]Steam[/url], to give you answers to the most common topics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40308403/ce31372a1ee9657d769b8fcde0cdb3112baf1782.jpg[/img]

[b]@savanahwaddles on Instagram and Dragonknight8129#5696 on Discord ask...[/b]
[h3][b]Why did you decide to make Youtubers Life 2?[/b][/h3]

[i]"After releasing Youtubers Life 1, we noticed there were a lot of players enjoying this experience, and asking for more mechanics and options for the game. After going through a long development, you know, that's quite heartening! 

For a few years, we were adding new content according to the community's feedback, but there was a point when we wanted to implement new ideas that required a different game basis. Many players asked for more social features, which led us to build a city with peculiar characters to interact with. These technical changes required starting a new project, which has been also used to offer a different experience from the first title, thus incorporating new concepts such as customization, friendships, socials, channels, or trends.

We love the first title! Youtubers Life 1 has brought great concepts to how we create games, and after 5 years, we are still learning from all the experiences gathered together with the community.

Nice question! Thanks for asking!"[/i]



[b]CQuade comments on Steam...[/b]
[h3][b]How did you come up with the characters in Youtubers Life 2?[/b][/h3]

[i]"Creating a character, their personalities, and personal stories, was one of the most fun things during the development! We are not just fans of everything related to Youtubers, but also big lovers of films, comics, series, and fantasy! We wanted to create characters with strong personalities and unique stories and designs, inspired by those well-known references that many Youtubers may recognize.

That's why you may identify some characters just like Gigi who was inspired by the malicious Cruella de Vil from 101 Dalmatians, or you may recall Zane as the king of Atlantis, Aquaman! We also created Dorian inspired by Klauss, from The Umbrella Academy, 'cause we love that character! Also, Arrou may have some similarities with Green Arrow, 'cause we also include wanted to include superhero inspirations. 

You may even recognize the friendship story of Babamey from that old-school romance on a ship, Titanic, even if she didn't remember it yet, 'cause you know... it's been 84 years! Playing their missions can be just as much fun as it was for us to develop them... you may find some fascinating Easter eggs from different dimensions!

And not only the characters and their stories, but also many items around the city show that kind of inspiration to immerse you in the experience! Have you seen that peculiar board game from Geektopia? It may ring a bell if you saw Jumanji! Did you see that the function of the Er-Brainlyzer is inspired by the Men in Black's memory eraser? 

There are so many references around you, and we would never end if we tell you all of them! We hope you enjoy them and make your way as an emerging Youtuber even more fun!"[/i]



[b]mrkruppy13#2778 says on Discord...[/b]
[h3][b]In Youtubers Life 1, Mom is in the game. In the 2nd game, she is gone! What happened?[/b][/h3]

[i]"Youtubers Life 2 continues the path of Youtubers Life 1, where you have proven to be the most promising Youtuber, so Xavier invites you to NewTube City to reach new goals. Now you must make more decisions to decide how to develop your career, what trends to follow, which characters you want to interact with, where and how to create your content, or how to make the most of your time.

By the concept of moving to NewTube City, you start a new free independent life to reach new goals as a Youtuber, thus raising new levels of your career and focusing on how you want to develop and grow your channel, without worrying about studies or housework.

But don't worry! Moms are moms, and they are always with you, no matter what. She stays at her home, and is so happy that you managed to get there! And who knows... we may know more about her in a feasible future."[/i]



[b]@unanonimo444 on Instagram and doge#5268 on Discord say...[/b]
[h3][b]Why did they change the gameplay so much compared to Youtubers Life 1? Is there a connection between the first and the second game?[/b][/h3]

[i]"We launched Youtubers Life 1 5 years ago, and the idea of becoming a Youtuber has been evolving and growing until now. And you know, we didn't want to just make the same game but better, but rather incorporate new concepts to offer an up-to-date point of view on being a Youtuber. New social channels have appeared, and other channels have also become more relevant for every influencer, so we had to study carefully what was new, what changed, and what we should focus on.

Youtubers Life 1 offers a Tycoon and Strategic approach to being an influencer, where everything is more focused as a straight line. On the other hand, Youtubers Life 2 presents a broader world, with more freedom and where you decide how to use your time to explore and grow your channel.

Nowadays, trends are constantly changing, so the best way to get more likes and gain followers stands by this concept. You know, there is no magic formula to succeed, so all prior research may help you decide what you want to do next, and that's quite the challenge about being a Youtuber.

So, we developed Youtubers Life 2 to offer a new experience, learning from the first title and including new perspectives of what a Youtuber is meant to be. We hope that you enjoy it!"[/i]



[b]@buzzbuz7 asks on Twitter...[/b]
[h3][b]Why can’t we change our avatar's appearance again?[/b][/h3]

[i]"There are different options in Youtubers Life 2 to customize your avatar. Some of them might be by the naked eye, but you may need to search a little more and even increase your relationship with special characters to get advanced options and customizations. 

It is true that once you create your character and select your body type and skin color, you cannot change them after that, But that's what creating your own special Youtuber avatar is all about, right? We are convinced that customizing your own avatar in extremely crazy ways, can be much more fun and unique for every Youtuber. Otherwise, your fans won't recognize you!

You can easily change your clothes, including masks, dresses, cosplays, headphones, glasses, piercings, and more in your Dressing Room through your mobile app or by accessing your wardrobe at your home. You can spend some coins to buy new outfits in different places like Kiwi Clothes Store, Gianni Clothes Boutique, or Slater Surf, or even get new sets through side missions. 

If you want to give your avatar a completely new fresh look, you may need to visit the Lafayette Hair Salon. His hairdressing is amazing, and you didn't recognize yourself in the mirror! You can also access the shop at the desk to buy new options, including also beards, piercings, and even tattoos.

But that's not all! Did you see the secret door at Lafayette's? If you build a good friendship with him, he may allow you access there, thus adding physical customization options such as facial features, or even eyes or mouth enhancements, just in case you were interested in a cool facial lifting.

We hope that all these options allow you to customize your avatar in so many ways, so you can surprise your followers and even introduce new styles! We really love to see players sharing their avatars on social media and see how creative they are."[/i]



[b]EpicTimes asks on Steam...[/b]
[h3][b]What gave you the idea to make the plotline of Suzy's cheating and Gigi Maccarone's criminal activity? Thanks so much for making this game! It's so great![/b][/h3]

[i]"We are so happy that you are enjoying the game! Youtubers Life 2 has several references from films, literature, and comics, which will help make your daily life more fun in NewTube City.

Gigi Maccarone is a character inspired by Cruella de Vil, thus making her the perfect option to bring organized crime back to NewTube City. Since the gaming industry is one of the most important things in the city, manipulating gaming tournaments for her personal profit was a clear idea. 

On the other hand, we have Suzy, the Spicy Ren Chinese restaurant's old chief who is not very familiar with video games yet. Suzy is quite similar to Gigi, since both are very persistent and they won't stop until reaching their goals. In a world ruled by young people, Suzy also wants to have her personal spot and be part of it. Her story brings the vision that it is never too late to learn something new, nor too old to pursue new dreams, thus highlighting the importance of taking care of ourselves."[/i]



[b]Agent J#3581 mentions on Discord...[/b]
[h3][b]How long was development for Youtubers life 2 and how did you come up with the characters[/b][/h3]
[i]"The development of Youtubers Life 2 was nearly 2 years of work. Not only the development itself, but the analysis of what things had changed nowadays in the world of Youtubers, and how we could improve and make the experience of becoming a Youtuber even more fun. 

Each superstar has a unique personality and is surrounded by incredible stories that they always bring to their channel to engage their fans, and that's how that extreme stuff is born and they become more and more trending! We wanted to give players that same feeling, that everything could happen in NewTube City, and we merged our passion for literature, comics, and films with it to create a city full of unique stories and a wide variety of different personalities, thus giving players more options to create unique content, and anecdotes that will motivate them to record for their next video on the channel."[/i]



[b]MakingBaconPancakes#0781 and TheOfficialTakeASoda#7701 on Discord, and @anthony.h17 on Instagram ask...[/b]
[h3][b]Are you planning on expanding the game more? What do you think will be the future of YouTubers Life 2? Any huge updates that are yet to be announced?[/b][/h3]

[i]While developing YL2, we did it with one goal in mind: that players could feel the experience of becoming real Youtubers in a city created to meet their dreams. Now that we have just launched the game, we are focused on analyzing all the feedback that we've received, thus working on some updates to improve the final experience even more. 

The idea of ​​being a Youtuber evolves over time, and that's also what would like to represent in Youtubers Life 2, so we keep working on it and studying the community's feedback to know what else we could include to boost that goal. 

Although it is still too soon to specify what new content we could include in the future, what we can say now is that Youtubers Life 2 has a long road ahead, and we are working on a roadmap of contents focused on improving your experience as a true Youtuber. Stay tuned to our social channels to know more!"[/i]



[b]NickMck07#7124 on Discord, @d0ne39 on Twitter, and @veryimportantpitties on Instagram comment..[/b]
[h3][b]Do you have plans to make YouTuber’s life 3? It’d be a big plan, but also do you have any plans for your company in general?[/b][/h3]

[i]"You are right, that'd definitely be a big plan! Although we have developed several video games, Youtubers Life 2 is the one that we are more focused on right now. That means that our current goal is to make Youtubers Life 2 the best experience possible for our players.

We have lots of plans for Youtubers Life franchise, but none of them has been fully landed yet. Right now we want to focus on improving Youtubers Life 2, while we keep working on the future of the Franchise.

Then, what would you like to see in the future for the Youtubers Life franchise?"[/i]



[b]Broskimate#5803 asks on Discord...[/b]
[h3][b]Are there any plans in the future for YL2 on Android and iOS? And keep up the amazing work you guys have been putting out🙂[/b][/h3]

[i]"This is one of the most frequently asked questions, and we couldn't help but come up with a more detailed answer for you! 

As you probably know, the first title in the franchise was released on all platforms, including mobile, some time after its PC release. This usually happens because other platforms require different development processes, additional time, and careful considerations of whether the game would fit on that platform.

Launching Youtubers Life 2 on mobile is something that we'd love to do too, but there are several factors we are still studying internally to see how we could adapt the game to its mobile version. Right now, all our efforts are focused on improving the Youtubers Life 2 experience for all our players on PC and Consoles, and we hope we can also bring this great experience to our mobile players in the future."[/i]


Thank you everyone for your amazing questions! 

Did you enjoy the #AskTheDevYL2? Let us know if you would like us to run another one in the future! And don't forget to follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/youtubers_uplay]social media[/url] and join our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1493760/discussions/0/3199245116725303742/]Discord Server[/url] to stay tuned!

notes.title: STUCK ON YOUR MISSIONS? CHECK OUT THIS NEW GUIDE TO MASTER YOUR YOUTUBER TASKS!
notes.content:
What's up, Youtuber!

[h3][i]"It's just 8 in the morning... What should I do?"[/i][/h3]
Checking your mobile phone is usually one of the first things you do when you wake up, right? Well, that's also a good habit in Youtubers Life 2, since great adventures are waiting for you on your Journal app today, so get ready early in the morning for what's to come... unless the sheets wouldn't let you go!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40308403/1ad45e8aa64c378819823f95b3080383a145f7ea.jpg[/img]

But do not rush and take your time to check all the options, 'cause sometimes you may find many different missions there. So, what should you focus on? Maybe you want to get some cash to improve your setup, investigate a new upgrade for your drone, or just hang out with that special person that makes your days better!

Check out our latest video and read on to make the most of Youtubers Life 2! And don't forget to take some notes.

[previewyoutube=vCt4SbFG6w8;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2][b]Main Quests[/b][/h2]
[h3][b]Become the best Youtuber and the Hero of NewTube City![/b][/h3]
Enjoy your way as an emerging Youtuber and become a legend is the main objective of Youtubers Life 2. Not only will you be able to gain millions of subscribers on your channel, but also become the hero of NewTube City!

All these main quests aim to this objective, so don't forget to keep progressing through them to reach fame! Here is everything you need to know before starting your journey:
[list]
[*] Main quests show up in [b]the first tab of your Journal[/b], so it will be the first thing you will see as a quest in Youtubers Life 2. To unlock new main quests, you may need to complete the current ones.
[*] [b]Each quest shows a description, an objective, and a reward.[/b] The description has relevant info about what you should do or what you should pick up to complete the mission. The objective reveals the requirements you must meet to complete the quest, such as the position of the NewTube ranking you should reach.
[*] Once you choose the quests you want to focus on, you can [b]pin them up to track them on the right-bottom side of your screen[/b] while exploring the city. This allows you to quickly access the quest info whenever and wherever you want. Choose wisely, 'cause [b]you can only undertake 3 missions, no matter the kind, at the same time.[/b]
[*] Some missions may require you to grow your channel, reach a higher position on the ranking, or solve a dangerous hacking in NewTube City, but all this is meant to [b]reach the glorious fame you deserve.[/b]
[*] After completing a specific main quest, your next target to become the best Youtuber will be unlocked and automatically pinned, so you won't lose track of [b]the grand finale. [/b]
[/list]
No one will be able to stop you after completing the main story and becoming the best Youtuber in the world. But, if you want to keep enjoying the experience, there are also secondary missions and secret features you can discover, so let's check what else you can do as a Youtuber!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40308403/aa6690037307ca17bf86ef76a7ea3d99a0168d4b.jpg[/img]


[h2][b]Side Quests[/b][/h2]
[h3][b]Know everything about the game features and get succulent prizes![/b][/h3]
There are a ton of things that you can do as a Youtuber in NewTube City, and it may be a bit overwhelming sometimes... that's why there are other quests that are not directly focused on the main objective, but they aim to help you make the most of your adventure to fame.

Here are the key tips to master your side quests:
[list]
[*] You will receive side quests while progressing in the game, and they will appear in the [b]second tab of your Journal.[/b] As for main quests, you can pin the one you prefer to quickly access the info at any time.
[*] These quests also have a description that indicates the reason for the quest, and an objective that sums up [b]what you need to do to complete it.[/b]
[*] To [b]unlock additional side quests,[/b] you may need to complete another one before it. For example, to go through the "Upgrade your drone with Streaming" quest, you need to finish the first "Developer Day" quest from Spring 15 onwards. 
[*] You will learn more about drone upgrades, customization, how to improve your recordings, and other activities you can do in your home or out there. You may also [b]get worthy prizes[/b], such as a trending video game or an exclusive piece of customization, to get unique trends and advantages that will boost your next content.
[*] Real Youtubers like [b]PewDiePie, Crainer, Rubius, LaurenzSide, Inoxtag, Paluten, and more[/b] have also a dedicated side quest! Each quest will be automatically unlocked after reaching a specific day, depending on your language settings, so don't lose your chance to meet some of the greatest Youtubers to get exclusive rewards and trends!
[/list]
The more side quests you complete, the more experience you will accumulate as a Youtuber, so take your time to investigate them and use your knowledge to advance on your main quests!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40308403/f677f4b678a98be2a47169851714918c505ba432.jpg[/img]


[h2][b]Commission Quests[/b][/h2]
[h3][b]Get easy cash to purchase new items and upgrades![/b][/h3]
Ok, we know that money cannot buy happiness, but it does buy that cool new-gen console you always wanted or the Pro Headphones you saw the other day at the store...

Although coins don't grow on trees for Youtubers either, there are plenty of easy tasks you can do to help other citizens for a quick buck. You may need to record a video to promote a certain brand, or just upload a new photo and reach a certain number of likes. All these collaborations will let you earn some savings for that new stuff you desire for your setup, or just to buy an additional upgrade to improve your next video. 

This is what you need to do to play your preferred Commission quests:
[list]
[*] First, go to your Commissions App and check the available tasks along with their description and, of course, the juicy reward they are offering. [b]These rewards may be higher as your reputation grows[/b], 'cause you know that big profiles don't have much time... and time is money!
[*] But do not be so greedy! You can [b]just accept and track up to 3 commission quests[/b] at once, so choose carefully to decide which one will be your next goldmine.
[*] Once you accept an available commission, it is automatically pushed to the [b]third tab of your Journal app[/b] as an active commission quest, so go to your Journal, check out the details one more time if you need it, and pin the quest to track it until its objective!
[*] You may need to upload a new promo photo, record and upload a video, stream a specific product, or deliver a secret package to another citizen. [b]Check out in the description what you need to find[/b] and who's asking, just in case you have to visit specific places to find them. 
[*] Keep an eye on the objective! Some quests may need to get a minimum number of likes or views along with your content. [b]The more subscribers you have, the more likes and views you will get[/b], so grow your followers first if you need it and complete the task. Some quests may need to be completed within the time limit, so try to [b]finish your quest before the time runs out![/b]
[*] After completing the commission quest, you will automatically receive the money within your pocket. You know what it is said: do not ask... just [b]take the money and run![/b]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40308403/6b1a961d6346a77cd0fd1f80badc87ca828bc994.jpg[/img]


[h2][b]Friendship Quests[/b][/h2]
[h3][b]Discover hidden stories and find your soulmate![/b][/h3]

[i]"Do you ever look at someone and wonder, what is going on inside their head?"[/i]

We know that Youtuber's personal lives are everything but boring with all those crazy videos, personal gossips, and experiences they live. So, [b]imagine what a City FULL of Youtubers can offer![/b]

Romances, secret fans, mutants, files with sensitive information... will you be able to keep your lips sealed, or will you be tempted to tell it all to your followers? 

Anyway, if you want to dive into their personal stories, and get unique rewards on the way, just go to the fourth tab of your Journal and start completing Friendship quests! And, who knows... you may find your soulmate on the way.

However, to learn more about them, you must earn their trust, which means visiting them often, talking to them, sharing photos, giving gifts... thus increasing your friendship level to gain more and more hearts!

So, how can you increase your friendship and go through these quests? Here is what you need to know:
[list]
[*] When you arrive at NewTube City the first time, your neighbors could adopt a detached attitude: they don't even know who you are.... but they will. So [b]start meeting them[/b] to say a lovely [i]hello[/i]! That's how every good friendship starts. 
[*] Once you encounter a relevant citizen you can build a relationship with, you may see two specific icons above their head: [b]The [i][b]"..."[/b][/i] icon means that you can talk to them to increase your relationship[/b] that day, and this usually happens once a day, so don't forget to visit those who you are most interested in. [b]The [i][b]"!"[/b][/i] icon shows that they have a friendship quest for you[/b], so go talk to them and receive a new quest to get exclusive prizes and keep accumulating hearts!
[*] [b]Taking some photos or giving them a gift[/b] according to their likes may also increase your relationship each day. Do not forget to check their likes, hates, and hobbies on your Contact list app to know more about them!
[*] After receiving your friendship quest, if you don't have 3 tracked quests already, it will be automatically pinned, so you can quickly [b]access the fourth tab in your journal[/b] and check all the details and the objective to complete it.
[*] You may discover some hidden stories, receive [b]special rewards for your channel[/b], or even unlock new interactions with them! 
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40308403/7730088827e85327fc1e789845072331ebd9644e.jpg[/img]


Reach the first position in the ranking, learn all you can do as a Youtuber, earn fresh cash to upgrade your stuff, and grow your contact network to live fun adventures and become the best Youtuber in the world!

We hope that these tips and guides help you to become the best Youtuber in the world! We encourage you to visit our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1493760/discussions/?snr=1_2108_9__2107]Steam discussions[/url] or participate in our [url=https://discord.com/invite/aDEmU2j7KC]Discord server[/url] to know even more.

notes.title: MASTER YOUTUBERS LIFE 2! HOW TO BECOME THE BEST YOUTUBER
notes.content:
Hey, Youtubers,

You know that becoming the best Youtuber and reaching the first position in the NewTube ranking is your final goal in Youtubers Life 2. So, we are now sharing a new guide for you to master your Youtuber career, including several tips to make the most of your day.

Check out the new guide right here!
[previewyoutube=Kvas19AQAUQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2][b]NewTube Channel[/b][/h2]
[h3][b]Record videos to publish new trending content![/b][/h3]
Your new life as an emerging Youtuber starts with the creation of your NewTube channel, and it reaches its most important stage when you get the first position in this ranking. 

First of all, choose your original nickname (you can change it later if you want) and start recording videos to upload them to your channel and keep growing. You can record from your console, computer, or even outside! there are plenty of options to create a VOD for your NewTube channel, so keep an eye on what's trendy that day to choose the best options and gain more subscribers! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40308403/4cc10cb459e39c32de42b976d1b6fe13696b92fe.jpg[/img]

Here are different ideas to upload innovative content to your channel:
[list]
[*] [b]Record Commentary videos from your computer.[/b] Cause you know, there's no place like home!
[*] [b]Record Gameplays, Tutorials, First Impressions, Speedruns, or Analysis[/b] videos from your gaming corner at home. Each script, console, and video game are associated with different trends, and they are evolving constantly, so choose the one that will boost your channel the most!
[*] [b]Record Vlogs or Interviews[/b] videos outside on different recording points. Explore the city to find them and complete different daily quests and tasks!
[*] [b]Record Unboxing videos[/b] from your Unboxing desk. All you need is a package that you can open and reveal to your fans!
[*] You can even save your [b]live streamings[/b] to then upload them as VODs to your NewTube channel. Check out the Glitch channel section below to know more about streamings.
[*] To help you with your editions, you can also install [b]additional workspaces[/b]. Check out the Editing section below to know more!
[*] To get high scores when recording a video, besides the special trends included in your recording, be sure that you have got good [b]reaction cards[/b]. During the recording minigame, each selected card will fill the emojis above, so the final score will be better as more emojis are completely filled at the end, so getting rare reaction cards by completing quests or growing as Youtuber is a must for your career!
[/list]
Once you upload a video, you can open your NewTube app across your mobile menu and check how many views, subs, coins, and likes have you earned with each upload.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40308403/e23c23889abe77926ac7eeca8e5496585e408bdc.jpg[/img]


[h2][b]Editing[/b][/h2]
[h3][b]Polish your content before posting it![/b][/h3]
After recording your video, you will generate clips that you can edit afterward. Although editing may be an easy process, it can require some good skills if we want to unleash its full potential. Here you can check the main steps before uploading your content:
[list]
[*] [b]Access your computer[/b] to edit a video that was previously saved in your drone's memory. Select your preferred video and start editing!
[*] The next screen will show you all the clips that you can use in your video. Each clip includes certain nodes that you should connect with each other, so try different places and designs. Don't worry if you don't use all of them, cause [b]every Youtuber chooses the best scenes to create their content![/b] 
[*] You will spend [b]render points[/b] when including a new clip, but you can also use them to add effects through the post-production options, thus increasing the final quality of your video! You will be able to choose among transition effects, copyright editions, and many more upgrades, and you will need to buy them with coins before using them, so choose your preferred effect carefully! To know more about how to increase your render points please check the Setup section below.
[*] After editing your video, your creation is almost done! You just need to [b]select the thumbnail[/b] you like the most and [b]write a title[/b] for your video. You will even find the option to include a clickbait title that will boost your visibility, but this may also annoy some of your followers, so don't overuse it!
[*] Once everything is done, you can upload the video and start getting new subscribers! Not only can you get new subs, but also a lot of coins to buy new stuff to upgrade your upcoming content!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40308403/ce3366f98290e7e5b2f9c734ccd8b89450890ed4.jpg[/img]

This is what Youtubers always do, right? But that is not all, as you can even install new workspaces at your home to help you with your videos:
[list]
[*] The [b]Audio Editing Board[/b] allows you to improve the video quality. It just takes a few hours and you can do other things in the meantime, like searching for other trends and recording more content!
[*] The [b]Video Editing Board[/b] will automatically edit your video. It also takes a few hours and you can keep doing other things meanwhile!
[*] The [b]Unboxing Desk[/b], the [b]Gaming Corner[/b], or the [b]Computer[/b] are essential workspaces to record your videos, or stream live, so be sure that you have at least one of them!
[/list]
Some of these workspaces can be upgraded to improve their usability and look by spending some coins. There are several options, so choose the one that fits your style better! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40308403/8be063a7e57aa4025db114a9616eaf05697c2a8c.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Glitch App[/b][/h2]
[h3][b]Stream live to get instant fans and coins![/b][/h3]
Streaming life is a genius way to get closer to your fans and gain instant cash! You can stream from your home or outside. To show the frenetic rhythm of the live videos, the minigame is slightly different from the rest of the recordings, so you will have to be fast to engage your fans and reach the first position as the most viewed Youtuber of the moment! You will also find different scripts, like IRLs or Interviews, depending on the place or if there's a trending celebrity that you may want to show in your next video!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40308403/55c7e6548d4a3720e47329e89c179097e85dc4eb.jpg[/img]

Also, you can open your Glitch app to check out other streamers' stats, as well as the expected viewing figures to know what time is the best for you to stream, and more! This may give you some good data to [b]keep growing as an emerging Youtuber![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40308403/7133c553e3d4f27297e6c742cf56f07668d4fd90.jpg[/img]


[h2][b]Setup[/b][/h2]
[h3][b]Improve your place to grow your channel![/b][/h3]
Your setup may be one of the most important and coolest things as a Youtuber, so feel free to book some time to improve it!

You can visit the Leet Point store, in the Center neighborhood, to buy new top-quality components for your computer, such as [b]RAM, Hard Drives, USB Ports, Processors, or Graphic Cards[/b]. Each component will add a certain number of [b]render points[/b] to your computer, so the better the component is, the higher number of render points you will be able to spend while editing your videos.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40308403/21245ec48a23167310b39641af7ed166bd365af9.jpg[/img]

You can also improve your setup's look in different ways, thus [b]increasing your #Home value[/b] to be trendy and having the most suitable place you deserve as the upcoming best Youtuber in the world! 

You can purchase these new looks and upgrades with coins that you will get by uploading new videos on your channel, completing Commissions and Quests, or selling the items you don't need anymore, cause we know that money can't buy happiness, but it may help you acquire useful stuff, right?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40308403/5472d1533eacb06b05fed730b955416494331c37.jpg[/img]


[h2][b]InstaLife App[/b][/h2]
[h3][b]Take photos to capture trends for your videos![/b][/h3]
One of the coolest things about being a celebrity nowadays is the possibility of capturing your best moments whenever and wherever you want! To do that, you can make the most of your InstaLife app and upload your finest selfies to capture top trends. To know which trends can be captured, you just need to check that they have the icon [b]"Trend to be captured"[/b]. Check out the "Top Trends" section on your mobile menu to know the best ones of the day!

Once you have captured the trend you were looking for, you can then record a new video for your NewTube channel and boost the final results to gain even more subscribers!

And that's not all, cause InstaLife is not only aimed at catching trends, but also a useful tool to know [b]what's actually happening and trendy in NewTube City[/b]. Is there a new game releasing this week? Or maybe an important event that you cannot miss? Check out your feed and discover more about all of that! notes.title: NEW PATCH 1.2.2 IS NOW LIVE!
notes.content:
Dear youtubers,

As we promised, [b]the new Patch 1.2.2 based on your feedback is now live![/b]

This update addresses some of the most frequently reported issues since the game was released and introduces further improvements to stability and gaming experience. Here is the full list of fixes and changes:

[h2][b]Updated minigames[/b][/h2]
[b][i]Recording minigame:[/i][/b]
[list]
[*] Balanced the progress of the minigame: now you can get better scores as your level increases and it will be easier to shuffle good cards to record better videos. Also, the reaction of the character after completing the recording has been adjusted to show that the video is successfully finished.
[*] Now the emojis can be completely filled if you are close enough to fill them after finishing the recording, allowing you to get better scores.
[*] "REGULAR" type clips have been removed when recording a video.
[/list]
[b][i]Editing minigame:[/i][/b]
[list]
[*] If there are enough render points and coins left, a message now appears saying that effects can be added to clips before publishing.
[/list]
[b][i]Publishing videos:[/i][/b]
[list]
[*] Your character will better show the excitement of publishing videos according to your level as a youtuber.
[/list]
[h2][b]Onboarding[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Added new indications about how to use trends when publishing a new video.
[*] Adjusted the trend capture tutorial to make it more understandable.
[*] Initial coins have been increased, allowing you to take advantage of your first savings to get new stuff from the very beginning and start your new life right away.
[*] An additional quest has been added to emphasize the progression as an emerging youtuber. Start reaching the top 75th position and keep growing to be the greatest youtuber of all times.
[/list]
[h2][b]Trends and secrets[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Now trends related to a specific location are displayed on the map.
[*] Now you can check trends information about their type and location each day through your mobile.
[*] Added related trends to InstaLife posts, thus giving some clues about their location.
[*] Now secret characters will only appear on the streets, thus making it easier to find them.
[*] Pendrives are now better dispersed throughout the city and they appear since the beginning of the game, which makes these main quest items easier to find by chance. 
[/list]
[h2][b]Commissions and Quests[/b][/h2]
[b][i]Commissions:[/i][/b]
[list]
[*] Taking photos as a commission feature has been introduced earlier in the game.
[*] Commissions rewards have been balanced to make them less necessary for progression, allowing you to focus on other quests of your choice to grow as a youtuber.
[*] Included additional indications when you pick the first package up for delivery.
[*] Added additional information about the type and location of trends required to complete a commission.
[/list]
[b][i]Quests:[/i][/b]
[list]
[*] Now you can record any video to complete the quest #PlayCon.
[*] Now you can pin up to three quests to your HUD, allowing you to follow up more missions at once.
[*] Pin icon has been replaced with a more proper one.
[*] Quests pinned on your HUD now include days.
[*] Getting the ticket to PlayCon is now a side mission.
[*] PlayCon ticket price has been adjusted.
[*] PlayCon quest now indicates the time left until the event, allowing you to check how many days you have to complete the mission.
[*] Adjusted texts now remind the day that PlayCon starts.
[*] Once you get enough coins to purchase the ticket for PlayCon, the drone tells you where you can buy it.
[*] Characters related to the FreeTicketChallenge are now in transit areas, making them easier to find.
[*] Now just two photos are needed to complete the FreeTicketChallenge quest.
[*] Now it is also indicated how many photos are left to complete the FreeTicketChallenge quest.
[/list]
[h2][b]Events, Apps, and General Features[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Night time has been adjusted, thus reducing the hours when the drone's night vision is necessary to record videos. This will give you the chance to record outside later even if you haven't got this upgrade yet.
[*] Night Vision upgrade price has been reduced.
[*] A new scooter stop has been added near the Port house.
[*] The map app has been improved.
[*] Added new instructions at the beginning of the scooter exam.
[*] Added new instructions when you fail the scooter exam.
[*] Introduction to the scooter exam has been updated to make it more understandable.
[*] Now you can buy up to 4 games per day in Retro World.
[*] The seller has been placed outside the Retro World Store to give you additional instructions about it.
[*] Added a new message that indicates whether an item has been sent to the storage.
[*] Improved the reaction cards album: now it shows the name of the character who will give you a new reaction card when completing their mission, and all trends' names are now included in the album.
[*] You can access the PlayCon VIP zone now from the Gold League.
[/list]
[h2][b]NPCs[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a new message from the drone after taking your first photo with an NPC to indicate how the relationships work.
[*] Added real-time location information of the NPCs you already know in your Contacts app. Also, don't forget to check out the Character schedule section from our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1493760/view/3050618730209297336]Youtubers Life 2 guide[/url] to know more about their daily life.
[/list]
[h2][b]HUD and Updated Guides[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a new icon on some NPCs to show if there's any action available with them. This will happen when you meet a known NPC who has a new quest available, or if you haven't spoken to them that day yet, or if there are available dialogues during an event, or if they expect to receive a package through an accepted commission. 
[*] Energy increase/decrease are numerically displayed on the energy bar.
[*] Fixed an issue with the speed of our Drone's messages.
[*] Now the Drone's messages are properly queued when there is more than one at the same time.
[*] The Drone now reminds you that you can record a video using trends you have captured if you have enough energy before ending the day.
[*] Added a new animation while recording a video.
[*] Added a shortcut to the map.
[*] More NPCs will look at you as you grow as youtuber and get into new leages, and a new popup is also added to show the excitement of your subscribers.
[/list]
[h2][b]Bug Fixing and minor improvements[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed the Pendrives lost during a quest after using them, and the drone message won't display.
[*] Fixed the AM/PM format times, that now don't show double ""00s"".
[*] Fixed problems with corrupted save games.
[*] All trends are now displayed in those places where there are several trends.
[*] Circles on the grounds for photos have been removed so as not to be confused with the recording points.
[*] Fixed a bug in the InoxTag's quest.
[*] Fixed a bug in the Crainer's quest.
[*] Fixed a blocking bug during Suzy's heart scene.
[*] Fixed a bug when publishing a video through the editing workshop.
[*] Trends assigned to conferences are now displayed at the exit.
[*] Fixed a bug that slowed down the time since the second year.
[*] Fixed a visual bug that shows trends on InstaLife out of the post.
[*] HUD buttons now work properly when riding a scooter.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented recording ""Analysis"" videos in the PlayCon.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented energy consumption.
[*] NPCs on the streets are no longer shown on the subway in the Map App.
[*] Fixed a crash with the Arabic configuration.
[*] Fixed the widescreen display.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused some trends to lose progress.
[*] Fixed the bouncing when scrolling on InstaLife's feed.
[*] Removed the dates of furniture, clothing, and food in stores.
[*] Fixed a crash when changing scenes quickly.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented inputs in certain situations, just like in the streaming minigame.
[*] Fixed several camera bugs.
[*] Improved the keyboard control when moving a character.
[*] Adjusted the default resolution to 1920x1080.
[/list]
We hope that these fixes and improvements allow you to enjoy Youtubers Life 2 to its fullest. We will keep reading your feedback and working on upcoming patches to ensure that you experience the best of your adventures as an emerging youtuber. We also encourage you to visit our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1493760/discussions/?snr=1_2108_9__2107]Steam discussions[/url] or participate in our [url=https://discord.com/invite/aDEmU2j7KC]Discord server[/url], so we can take a closer look at your feedback and keep improving the game.

Happy gaming!

 [*][b]NewTube City has a lot of secrets[/b] waiting for you!! We don’t want to spoil you, but here are some things you will be able to do as you keep playing:

[list]
    [*]Update your drone with streaming function, night vision, bigger memory… record whenever you want, wherever you want!
    [*]As you discover new ways of creating content, more commission mechanics will become available! 
    [*]Order stuff from the AmazingOn App. Get food, games, game consoles, clothes… delivered to your home!
    [*]Learn new reaction cards, learn how to do unboxings, and buy new workspaces to automatically edit and upgrade your videos.
    [*]Upgrade your house and add new rooms, ask a friend character to move with you… or get married!
[/list]
 [*][b]Earn money with your videos:[/b] your videos will have a final score based on three different sections:
[list]

    [*]Recording: you can get up to 5 stars when you are recording your videos. Try to fill as many emojis as possible with your reaction cards!
    [*]Editing: try to connect all your clips together, and try to make as many connections between them as possible. Don’t forget you can add different postproduction effects to increase your editing score!
    [*]Trends: better trends mean better videos. You should try to catch a more popular trend instead of gathering a couple of them which are more common. 
[/list]
More views mean more money! If your subscribers are happy, they will check your videos. But if you are uploading amazing videos… more people will see them, more money will come in and they will also become subscribers. Double win!

 [*][b]Every youtuber has faced a tough beginning:[/b] do you feel like you don’t have enough energy to record tons of videos, enough money to get tons of food, and enough expertise to catch tons of great trends? That's ok!! Take it easy and keep playing. Don’t get obsessed with money or energy. Try to record and upload one video every day, be active on Instalife and use commissions to save some money during the first and hardest days, so you will be able to record more and more videos per day in no time!

Are you finding difficulties with delivery commissions? Take a look at our characters and locations guide below!

 [*]Meet NewTube people and make new friends!: [b]check your Contacts App and see how many characters are waiting for you at NewTube City![/b] All of them have a storyline with different associated quests. How can you improve your relationship with a character?

[list]
    [*]Talk to them on a daily basis: you will learn information about them, about Newtube City, and about other characters as well!
    [*]Upload a picture with them to InstaLife once a week: at the beginning, most of the characters won’t be very enthusiastic about your InstaLife posts… but they like them! Keep improving your relationship with them and they will show you soon they really like your selfies.
    [*]Give them gifts: each character has likes and dislikes. Try to discover them and give them some gifts! They will help you to progress through the relationship. 
[/list]
This information is displayed on a small pop-up every time you approach a character. If you have already performed an action from above, a small green tick will be shown!
